move_to_their_side.name: Move to Their Side of the Table
move_to_their_side.when: When writing sales or persuasion copy
move_to_their_side.method: Start across the table (seller vs buyer). End shoulder to shoulder (both looking at the decision together).

ghost_products_strategy.name: Ghost Products Strategy (Hormozi)
ghost_products_strategy.when: When designing offers or sales sequences
ghost_products_strategy.principle: Sell the outcome before the product exists. Validate demand before building.
ghost_products_strategy.source: Alex Hormozi — My Best Sales Tactic

pain_point_solution_gap.name: Pain Point Solution Gap
pain_point_solution_gap.method: Show the distance between where they are and where they want to be. Use hands, graphics, or examples to visualize the gap.
pain_point_solution_gap.why_it_works: Human brains are problem-solving machines — they fixate on unresolved gaps

point_of_difference.name: Point of Difference (Contrast)
point_of_difference.when: When creating contrarian or positioning content
point_of_difference.formula: 'Everyone says do Y — I say do Z'
point_of_difference.why_it_works: The brain constantly looks for easier, better, faster ways — curiosity loop keeps them watching

screenshots_visual_proof.name: Screenshots & Visual Proof
screenshots_visual_proof.when: When needing to build trust quickly
screenshots_visual_proof.method: Flash bank statements, A-B tests, before/after, social followings. One or two quick flashes = trust built.
screenshots_visual_proof.fallback: If no proof — use common ground: 'I've been exactly where you are'

illusion_of_novelty.name: Illusion of Novelty
illusion_of_novelty.formula: Reveal new aspect of a thing + tie it to outcome viewer wants
illusion_of_novelty.example: Root canal with robotics: zero needles, zero pain, back to work in 30 minutes

key_tactics: Emotion → Action. That's the game. All marketing boils down to one thing: can you get the viewer to feel an emotion that compels action?
If you can walk yourself around the table psychologically, it's one of the fastest ways to build trust
Screenshots create instant credibility better than credentials
Curiosity loops make viewers stay for the resolution
Contrast between common approach and your approach creates the strongest retention
The Pain Point Solution Gap works because brains are wired to solve problems
